scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Manufacturing Sector)
other_conditions: Must be a Micro, Small, or Medium enterprise
Must be a manufacturing enterprise engaged in the manufacturing sector
Must obtain term loan from a recognized bank or financial institution
Loan must be sanctioned before the enterprise starts commercial production
If installing a solar/renewable energy plant, it must be for captive consumption
Enterprise must bear a minimum of 2% interest on the term loan
Application must be submitted within the prescribed timeline
SC/ST entrepreneur contribution must be at least 51% of the enterprise
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy of 6‑8% on term loans up to ₹35 lakhs, with loan periods of 5–7 years depending on category.
